name: ListenBrainz
description: A plugin to send your music listening activity on Jellyfin to ListenBrainz. This is a fork of lyarenei/jellyfin-plugin-listenbrainz that can also export Jellyfin playlists and the whole music library to ListenBrainz playlists and keep them in sync.
overview: Track your music habits with ListenBrainz.

versions.changelog:
Fork of 6.6.2.1 (lyarenei/jellyfin-plugin-listenbrainz) with playlist export:
  - Export (mirror) Jellyfin playlists to ListenBrainz playlists
  - Export the whole music library as one ListenBrainz playlist
  - Changes are synced automatically: added, removed and reordered tracks
  - 6.6.2.102: library playlist ordered by track artist; quieter startup
